# Landed
> The outsourced senior commercial function for consumer goods brands, food and non-food: sales growth and account management across Australian grocery, pharmacy, independents and food service. We win listings and grow sales. Built from fifteen years on the supplier side of Australian grocery (Coles, Woolworths, Aldi, Metcash). Supplier-side and independent.

## Sales growth & account management
- /sales-account-management.html : The core offer. Winning distribution, buyer relationships, negotiation and trading terms, range reviews, promo and margin, for consumer goods brands across grocery, pharmacy, independents and food service. Deliberately commercial-only (not legal, finance, logistics or forecasting). Delivered three ways: advise (coaching), done with you, or done for you (outsourced commercial function). Also cohort training for accelerators and programs. Enquiry-based, scoped in a call, no public pricing. Contact: hello@landedfmcg.com

## Essays
- /essays/seven-numbers-a-buyer-checks.html : The seven numbers a supermarket buyer checks before deciding on your product, in order: rate of sale, price point, retailer margin, promo plan, source of volume, DIFOT, year-one funding.
- /essays/the-listing-is-not-the-win.html : Why getting into Coles is the entry fee, not the finish line. Around half of new grocery products don't survive year one; what surviving the first range review actually takes (pipeline fill, launch funding, rate of sale, the re-pitch).
- /essays/the-margin-you-keep.html : The real supplier P&L of a $5.99 supermarket product (retailer margin, trade spend, freight, COGS) and break-even scan rates.
- /essays/your-buyer-is-an-employee.html : The four KPIs supermarket buyers are measured on and how to pitch to their scorecard.
- /essays/the-meeting-is-the-delivery.html : The preparation system and 12-slide structure that wins retail listings.
- /essays/yes-if.html : FMCG negotiation for suppliers: positions vs interests, anchoring, conditional trading, BATNA.
- /essays/growing-broke.html : Promotional dependency: the 3:1 promoted-to-base scan rate ratio and promo ROI maths.
- /essays/the-second-product-problem.html : NPD commercialisation: the launch gate, velocity forecasting, funded trials.
